cards.name: Deep Waters 2
printedLines: You have been there more than
once. Yet we know little of the
area we call the cove. Now that the tide is
low, you should venture there once more and
map out the underground caverns carefully.
We know that something sinister lives there,
yet we can’t fathom where it resides.
Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms.

cards.name: Tainted Trinkets
printedLines: All that glitters is not gold, some
treasures bear a curse untold. These
tainted trinkets are waiting for you
to be purified, lest we risk getting corrupted by
their demonic influence. You know how...
Each Hero gets 1 level 3 Trinket at random,
those Trinkets are considered tainted. If a
Hero can’t get a Trinket, they choose one
of theirs to become tainted. When in an
Objective Room, a Hero can spend one action
in Area {icon:9120cba1df} (this can be done only once per
Room) to cleanse the Trinket and score one
objective. Upon returning to Hamlet, each
Hero with a tainted Trinket can suffer 2
negative Quirks and cleanse it, or remove it
and shuffle it back into its respective deck.
